name: GIOHuntingOnWeb
description: Hunt the web for learning-worthy insights and convert the high-impact/low-risk ones into GIOs (Guild Improvement Opportunities) in the GuildOS2 table. Sources: VIDEO (Bilibili + YouTube — extract a clean timestamped transcript), GITHUB (trending/searched repos — README, architecture, activity), and COMMENT/DISCUSSION sections (cheap, high-signal practitioner insight). Main scenario: the operator hands off a batch of "how to do AI better" sources (channels, videos, repos) for studying + GIO generation. Triggers on: extract subtitles / captions / transcript from a video, get the text of a Bilibili / YouTube video, transcribe a video, study these videos/channels/repos, mine comments for insights, hunt GitHub for agentic ideas, find guild improvement opportunities, turn web content into GIOs. Core discipline: (1) a video EXTRACTION LADDER cheapest-first — native caption track BEFORE ASR BEFORE OCR; (2) COMMENTS are the cheapest insight source, mine them by default; (3) JUDGE, don't obey — only genuinely high-impact/low-risk findings become GIOs, never manufacture GIOs from what the guild already does, and 0 GIOs is a valid outcome. Proven: Bilibili native-subtitle + comment APIs (login via Claude-in-Chrome; fetch subtitle CDN credential-less), YouTube UI transcript-panel scrape (the direct timedtext API is token-gated). Output contract: GIOs POSTed to GuildOS2 /api/gio, reviewed in the GM Room.
author: GuildOS
